entities.summary: The Church of Corpus Domini, also known as the Chiesa della Santa is a Roman Catholic church in Bologna. It is part of an active monastery complex of the order of Clarissan nuns, that is nuns of the contemplative Second Order of St. Francis. The monastery is semi-cloistered. Corpus Domini, Bologna is a monastery in Europe, established in 1456-07-31. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
